cases.question: What remains when a filtered salt solution is dried?

reason.en: the last of the water is gone and {names} are still shown as dissolved, which is not a state a beaker can be in. What they crystallise into is not decidable from the ions alone, so the bench will not guess at the solids

diagnostics.what: the last of the water is gone and silicon dioxide (quartz), chloride ion and sodium ion are still shown as dissolved, which is not a state a beaker can be in. What they crystallise into is not decidable from the ions alone, so the bench will not guess at the solids
